The conflict was a peer dependency mismatch: `@semantic-release/changelog@^5.0.1` required `semantic-release >=15.8.0 <18.0.0`, while the project uses `semantic-release@^21.0.2`.

Changes:
- `package.json`: bumped `@semantic-release/changelog` from `^5.0.1` to `^6.0.3` (peer `semantic-release >=18.0.0`, compatible with v21). The other semantic-release plugins (`/npm`, `/commit-analyzer`, `/release-notes-generator`) already accept v21.
- `package-lock.json`: regenerated so the lockfile stays in sync (`changelog` resolved to `6.0.3`).

Verification: a clean `npm ci --ignore-scripts` installed 882 packages with no ERESOLVE error (only pre-existing engine/deprecation warnings, since Node here is v16).
